Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator

Class SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceReport extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, bounded accounting of the energy equation actually consumed by a transient separator.

Positive inlet enthalpy and external heat add energy; outlet enthalpies remove it. Enthalpies retain the equation of state's caloric reference and can be negative. This report distinguishes the accepted VU solve's local defect from the accumulated difference between inventory energy and integrated boundary transfers. Numerical values describe the last accepted update, while coverage and attempt counters include later skipped updates. It is not a physical-model, process-response, or safety qualification.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
